units.function: Embedded-Postgres route tests for Agent/human comment and PATCH attribution, persisted activity receipts, activity retrieval and audited rejection of delegated-human spoofing.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest -> Issue/activity routes -> real authz, Issue and activity services -> PostgreSQL principals, memberships, Runs, comments, Issues and activity log.
units.keyDataModels: Agent/human actor, on-behalf membership, responsibleUserId on Run, Issue comment creator/Run metadata, PATCH before/after changes, authorization reason and spoof-rejection activity.
units.lifecycle: Authenticate actor/delegation -> authorize visible cross-Issue write -> derive Agent/Run/human attribution -> persist comment or PATCH -> persist/query activity receipt; reject and audit client-supplied attribution override.
units.testAssessment: Both tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Source validates a strong receipt shape, but atomic rollback, terminal-Work policy, delegation mismatch/revocation, idempotency and audit immutability are not established.
units.designRationale: Make cross-Issue Agent collaboration explainable by preserving the executing Agent, runtime, accountable human and authorization reason, while preventing payload fields from overriding authenticated attribution.
units.companyOsProblem: Every executable or consequential Work mutation must answer which Agent acted, under which Run and capability, for which accountable human, with what exact change and evidence, including denied attempts.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the server-derived Agent/Run/human tuple, structured authorization reason, field-diff receipts, queryable activity and audited spoof denial. Add immutable ordered receipts, action/work/contract/evidence digests, transactional outbox/rollback, delegation version/expiry, terminal-Work policy, target-human notice/approval, idempotency and safe redaction of attacker-controlled values.
units.responsibilityConflict: A visible-write grant permits an Agent to mutate another Agent's done Work without asserted responsible-human approval, and persisted activity is not proven immutable or atomic. Raw spoof values may leak attacker-supplied sensitive data into audit storage.
units.securityFindings: HIGH terminal/cross-owner mutation gap: done foreign Work is mutable under visible-write. HIGH atomicity/immutability gap: audit failure rollback and tamper evidence are absent. HIGH untrusted-audit-data gap: spoof requestedValue is stored raw. HIGH verification gap: both database tests skipped. MEDIUM delegation gap: Run/human/membership mismatch, expiry and revocation are untested. MEDIUM replay gap: duplicate comments/PATCH and concurrent writes lack idempotency/version checks.
